translations.EN: I couldn't start following you.
translations.TL: Hindi ko masimulan ang pagsunod sa iyo.

translations.EN: Failed to follow. Path was obstructed.
translations.TL: Bigo sa pagsunod. May harang sa daan.

translations.EN: I tried to follow, but got caught on something.
translations.TL: Sinubukan kong sumunod, pero naipit ako sa kung saan.

translations.EN: Lost your trail. Couldn't keep following.
translations.TL: Nawala ang bakas mo. Di nakasunod.

translations.EN: Unable to follow through that passage.
translations.TL: Di makasunod sa lagusang 'yan.

translations.EN: Follow command failed. Way is blocked.
translations.TL: Pumalpak ang utos na sumunod. Barado ang daan.

translations.EN: I couldn't match your route.
translations.TL: Hindi ko nasabayan ang ruta mo.

translations.EN: Blocked off. Can't follow that way.
translations.TL: May harang. Di makasunod sa daang 'yan.

translations.EN: Attempted to follow, but lost visual.
translations.TL: Sinubukang sumunod, pero nawala sa paningin.

translations.EN: Can't reach you to follow. Clear the path.
translations.TL: Di kita maabot para sumunod. Hawiin ang daan.

translations.EN: Okay, I'll follow you.
translations.TL: Sige, susundan kita.

translations.EN: Right behind you.
translations.TL: Nasa likod mo lang ako.

translations.EN: Following now. Lead the way.
translations.TL: Sumusunod na ngayon. Mauna ka.

translations.EN: Understood. Sticking close behind.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Didikit sa likod mo.

translations.EN: Moving with you. Lead on.
translations.TL: Kumikilos kasabay mo. Mauna na.

translations.EN: I'm with you. Let's move.
translations.TL: Kasama mo ako. Kilos na.

translations.EN: Right on your tail. Watching our rear.
translations.TL: Nasa buntot mo lang. Binabantayan ang likod.

translations.EN: Following your pace. Keep going.
translations.TL: Sasabay sa bilis mo. Tuloy lang.

translations.EN: Understood. Falling in behind you.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko. Papatabi sa likod mo.

translations.EN: Got it. Moving out with you.
translations.TL: Nakuha ko. Lalakad kasabay mo.

translations.EN: Of course, I'll follow you.
translations.TL: Siyempre, susundan kita.

translations.EN: Gladly, friend! Lead the way.
translations.TL: Malugod, kaibigan! Ituro ang daan.

translations.EN: Always happy to travel with you. Let's go!
translations.TL: Laging masayang maglakbay kasama ka. Tara na!

translations.EN: I'm right behind you, partner. Let's do this.
translations.TL: Nasa likod mo lang ako, kasama. Gawin na natin ito.

translations.EN: Right with you, friend! Watch your steps.
translations.TL: Kasabay mo ako, kaibigan! Mag-ingat sa hakbang.

translations.EN: Wouldn't rather be following anyone else.
translations.TL: Wala nang ibang gugustuhin kong sundan kundi ikaw.

translations.EN: Lead on! I've got your six covered.
translations.TL: Mauna ka! Hawak ko ang likod mo.

translations.EN: Sure thing! Sticking like glue to you, friend.
translations.TL: Walang anuman! Didikit na parang pandikit sa 'yo, kaibigan.

translations.EN: Happy to follow. Keep us safe!
translations.TL: Masayang sumunod. Panatilihin tayong ligtas!

translations.EN: Right behind you, partner. Onward!
translations.TL: Nasa likod mo lang, kasama. Pasulong!

translations.EN: I'm still following you.
translations.TL: Sinusundan pa rin kita.

translations.EN: Already following right behind you.
translations.TL: Nakasunod na ako mismo sa likod mo.

translations.EN: Still on your heels. No need to repeat.
translations.TL: Nasa likod mo pa rin. Di na kailangang ulitin.

translations.EN: I haven't gone anywhere. Still right here.
translations.TL: Wala akong pinuntahan. Narito pa rin ako.

translations.EN: Following you already. Just keep walking.
translations.TL: Sumusunod na sa 'yo. Magpatuloy ka lang sa paglalakad.

translations.EN: I'm right behind you! Look over your shoulder.
translations.TL: Nasa likod mo lang ako! Lumingon ka sa balikat mo.

translations.EN: Still with you. Don't worry.
translations.TL: Kasama mo pa rin ako. Huwag kang mag-alala.

translations.EN: Already in tow. Lead the way.
translations.TL: Nakasunod na. Mauna ka na.

translations.EN: Following you as we speak.
translations.TL: Sumusunod sa 'yo habang nagsasalita ka.

translations.EN: I'm already following. Keep moving.
translations.TL: Sumusunod na ako. Tuloy lang sa paglakad.

translations.EN: I know you. I'll follow.
translations.TL: Kilala kita. Susunod ako.

translations.EN: I trust your lead completely. Following you.
translations.TL: Lubos akong nagtitiwala sa pangunguna mo. Susunod sa 'yo.

translations.EN: Lead the way, partner. I'm with you to the end.
translations.TL: Ituro ang daan, kasama. Kasama mo ako hanggang dulo.

translations.EN: You've proven your judgment. I'll follow anywhere.
translations.TL: Napatunayan mo na ang galing mo. Susunod ako kahit saan.

translations.EN: Understood. I trust you to keep us alive.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Tiwala akong bubuhayin mo tayo.

translations.EN: Right behind you. We watch out for one another.
translations.TL: Nasa likod mo lang. Nagbabantayan tayo sa isa't isa.

translations.EN: I'm at your side, friend. Lead on.
translations.TL: Nasa tabi mo ako, kaibigan. Mauna ka.

translations.EN: You make the calls, I back you up. Following.
translations.TL: Ikaw ang magpasya, susuportahan kita. Sumusunod.

translations.EN: I know you have my back. Following your lead.
translations.TL: Alam kong hawak mo ang likod ko. Sumusunod sa pangunguna mo.

translations.EN: Understood, partner. Right behind you.
translations.TL: Naiintindihan ko, kasama. Nasa likod mo lang.

translations.EN: I'll follow.
translations.TL: Susunod ako.

translations.EN: Fine. Walking behind you.
translations.TL: Sige. Lalakad sa likod mo.

translations.EN: Following. Whatever.
translations.TL: Sumusunod. Kahit ano pa.

translations.EN: Understood. Moving.
translations.TL: Naintindihan. Kumikilos.

translations.EN: Right behind. Don't stop suddenly.
translations.TL: Nasa likod lang. Huwag hihinto nang bigla.

translations.EN: I'll keep up.
translations.TL: Sasabay ako.

translations.EN: Following. Keep going.
translations.TL: Sumusunod. Tuloy lang.

translations.EN: All right. Let's go.
translations.TL: Sige. Tara na.

translations.EN: Behind you.
translations.TL: Nasa likod mo.

translations.EN: Moving along.
translations.TL: Sumasabay.

translations.EN: I can't follow you right now.
translations.TL: Hindi kita masusundan ngayon.

translations.EN: I need to stay here. Can't follow.
translations.TL: Kailangan kong manatili rito. Di makasusunod.

translations.EN: Refusing to follow into that danger.
translations.TL: Tumatangging sumunod sa panganib na 'yan.

translations.EN: Too exhausted or injured to keep up. I can't follow.
translations.TL: Masyadong pagod o sugatan para sumabay. Di makasusunod.

translations.EN: I have business here. You go on ahead.
translations.TL: May inaasikaso ako rito. Mauna ka na.

translations.EN: Can't follow. My hands are full.
translations.TL: Di makasusunod. Marami akong ginagawa.

translations.EN: Not following you into that mess.
translations.TL: Di kita susundan sa gulong 'yan.

translations.EN: I won't follow you right now.
translations.TL: Hindi kita susundan sa ngayon.

translations.EN: Stay back, I'm not following.
translations.TL: Umatras ka, di ako susunod.

translations.EN: Follow order rejected. I'm holding position.
translations.TL: Tinatanggihan ang utos na sumunod. Hawak ko ang pwesto.
